listing.name: sidebarLib
listing.summary: Adds a customizable foldable sidebar on the left side of the screen with configurable buttons and multi-key actions.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a customizable foldable sidebar on the left side of the screen with configurable buttons and multi-key actions.

description:
sidebarLib

DOWNLOAD:

https://www.mediafire.com/file/j59uf6p3ziz9htq/sidebarLib-20260609.zip/file

INFO:

Spoiler[close]A small library, if you can call it that even, with the goal of coalescing all the various custom ui elements added by all different mods. it all started with me needing to add a ui button and coming to a realization that several someones have already claimed that specific spot on the screen.

This mod adds a small foldable sidebar on the left part of the screen, which contains small buttons, not unlike paint/photoshop toolbar, the size and arrangement of buttons can be configured in settings.json.

Each button can have up to three different actions, depending on which button (CTRL/ALT/SHIFT) is held when pressing it (can also be changed in settings.json).

compatible mods:

SpoilerbananaFactory:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=31532.0

systemRescan:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=32910.0

safeTravels:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=33086.0

THREAT DETECTED:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=32565.0

biggerAbilityBar:

https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=35575.0

[close]

Known issues:

Spoilerfor some reason after loading a save some buttons or widgets may stop working

in theory

loading a save should purge any instance of sidebar, or it's subordinate plugins from memory, and it shouldn't be able to save itself into memory to begin with

in practice

something prevents it from happening, sometimes. creating a new save copy, however, purges everything and reinitializes everything

again

[close]

USAGE:

Every button is added via

data/config/sidebarLib_buttons.csv

:

"id" - String - must be unique, needs for loading the csv.

"name" - String - human-readable name, displayed to the player.

"order" - int - buttons are sorted and placed in ascending order, bigger the number lower it will be in the list. Buttons with the same order are placed in the order they were read from csv.

"plugin" - String - reference to the plugin defining the button, must be extension of

sidebarLib.buttons.sidebarButton

. Said plugin provides all the necessary methods to actually

do

things. the method names _should_ be self-explanatory enough, but i will explain things if the need arise

the button itself is self-updating, refreshes when it is pressed, or whenever

rebuild()

is called.

also included a silly little mod to serve as an example:

https://www.mediafire.com/file/v9hr9hxduw5q302/sblex-20250415.zip/file

COMPATIBILITY:

This mod has no external dependencies or incompatibilities, beyond possibly occupying the same space as someone else's ui widget (i know at least two), but since it is literally the problem it is made to address, i consider that a feature.

it is made with java 17, contains no reflection, kotlin, or any other questionable code.

all source is included in the archive. you can decompile to verify (you really should).

there is no github repository, and never will be, unless someone else takes it off my hands.

if any issues or misunderstandings arise, please don't hesitate to contact me diretly on discord, or here via dm.

- internal restructuring

[close]

audaxludos - his name should be immortalized in stone, for inventing that plain-java-ui-renderer

kaysaar - for helping me wrap my head around most of the UI nonsense, and convincing me to actually publish this

aiDescription: Adds a small, foldable sidebar on the left side of the screen that holds customizable buttons similar to a toolbar. Each button can have up to three different actions based on which modifier key (CTRL/ALT/SHIFT) is held. The sidebar's state and button configurations persist across save/load, and its layout and behavior can be adjusted via a settings file. It is designed to help unify UI elements from other mods and reduce conflicts.
